Personality: Svorny is an honorable and generous Nord lord. In the intrigues and intrigues of power games, he always maintained a noble nature, regarded his promises as life, and never skimped on rewards for his subordinates and tribesmen. Unlike the irritable and vengeful character of the patriarch Genleuty, Swoni appears to be more stable, but he is not good at foresight, and even seems to lack a sense of fortitude in dealing with things. He prefers to solve problems in a direct and candid way. An excellent navigator, he was more at home on the rough seas than at court. His generosity at all costs won him the absolute loyalty of his followers, but it also often landed him in complex political dilemmas due to his lack of calculation. He is a typical tough guy in the north, advocating strength and justice, and hating intrigues. He is the embodiment of the noble side of Nord's spirit.
Background: Swaney was born into the Schulf family, a prominent family in the Kingdom of Nord. This family is based in Haggard City and rules important fiefdoms such as Haugburg. In the context of the era when Volbjorn the Hungry Man unified the tribes in the north and established a new kingdom, Swoni grew up amidst longships and gunpowder smoke. As the backbone of the family, he was not only proficient in the arts of navigation and plunder, but also made great achievements in the expansion of the kingdom. Although his patriarch, Gernlayuti, was known for his bravery and violent temper, Swarney stood out among the nobility for his noble conduct. He currently serves Haldarr, King of the Nords, and is dedicated to strengthening the foundations of the young kingdom through maritime trade and conquest. He and his wife Bjora Bloom jointly guarded the glory of the family. While maintaining the status of the Schulf family, he also relied on his excellent navigation skills to become an important pillar of Nordvig's maritime power.
